description: v2.2.8 (pre-release): adds Meesho (com.meesho.shopping, XAPK splits, targets 29.9/29.8/29.7/29.6/29.5) app-scoped entries — 'Meesho: Block analytics & tracking SDKs', 'Meesho: Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer)', 'Meesho: Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs' (same heuristics, off by default, unverified on device) — plus docs/MEESHO.md. Amazon AMOLED resource pass restricted to android: framework attributes (fixes 'Unknown attribute name: colorSurface' build failure on mShop 32.19.0.300); Mereframe diagnostic crash log now records app versionName/versionCode; native-integrity bypass logs its planting. 2026-11-06 build included universal ExoPlayer autoplay heuristic, Mint/HT scoped entries, Indian-market tracker markers, HT analysis doc, v2.2.7 content (Brave, Reddit, Amazon AMOLED). No APK decompiled for Meesho — sponsored-suppression/AMOLED for Meesho pending the APK; Premium unlocks are server-side and impossible. Unverified on device.
